criteria.name: End-to-End Vertical Slice Coverage
criteria.description: Story includes an end-to-end integration test demonstrating database migration, API route, and user-facing UI slice.

scale.3: Complete vertical slice verified with runnable end-to-end integration test covering primary AC.
scale.2: Full stack implemented, minor omission in e2e test edge assertion.
scale.1: Frontend and backend present but disconnected without e2e verification.

criteria.name: Contract and Schema Integrity
criteria.description: Backend adheres strictly to schema.md and openapi.yaml; frontend consumes only contracted endpoints.

scale.3: Strict contract conformance across both layers with zero shortcuts or schema drift.
scale.2: Contract compliant, minor discrepancy in frontend error mapping.
scale.1: Shortcut taken: field bypassed without schema migration.

criteria.name: Back-to-Front Implementation Discipline
criteria.description: Migration first, then API endpoint & tests, then UI & tests.

scale.3: Clear back-to-front progression with discrete commits or clean layering.
scale.2: Proper layering, minor concurrent editing of UI and handler.
scale.1: Front-end created without working backend endpoint.

criteria.name: Security and Least Privilege
criteria.description: Server-side authorization enforced on endpoints; no secrets in frontend code; safe parameterized queries.

scale.3: Full security compliance across backend authorization and client-side credential hygiene.
scale.0: Hardcoded secret or SQL injection vulnerability.

criteria.name: UI States and Accessibility
criteria.description: All UI states handled (loading, empty, error); WCAG 2.2 AA compliant.

scale.3: Comprehensive UI states and verified keyboard accessibility.
scale.2: UI states present, minor styling polish on empty state.

criteria.name: Clean Execution, Types, and Tests
criteria.description: TypeScript compiler clean, linter clean, all backend and frontend tests pass.

scale.3: 100% green tests, 0 compiler errors, 0 linter warnings.
